_comment: Ashen Vale landform, read by Heightfield.from_dict. Metres, world XZ with the Mirror Pond at the origin. Layers compose in this order: noise hills -> valley-floor channel (calms the noise) -> pond basin -> boundary ridge -> plateaus. Slope targets: valley floor and routes <= 30 deg (player floor_max_angle is 45), ridge upper half > 45 so it reads as a wall.
_comment_holes: World XZ rects [x, z, w, h] where the terrain mesh AND collision are omitted so built structures can go underground. First: the castle crypt stairwell (tests/test_crypt_mouth.gd). Second: the stairwell down to the Hearth's chamber under the Mirror Pond, snapping to x -4..4, z -6..6 (tests/test_hearth_mouth.gd). Whatever is built must floor the SNAPPED hole, not the authored rect (D-014).
